passages.provision_quote: (42) human trafficking of a minor, in violation of subdivision (c) of Section 236.1, except, with respect to a violation of paragraph (1) of subdivision (c) of Section 236.1, where the person who committed the offense was a victim of human trafficking, as described in subdivision (b) or (c) of Section 236.1, at the time of the offense;
passages.note: Authored single-subject bill adding one offense to the serious-felony list for Three Strikes purposes, with a carve-out for trafficking victims.
passages.actor_quote: SB 14, Grove. Serious felonies: human trafficking.

rows.reasoning: Her authorship of SB 14 (2023-2024), which adds "human trafficking of a minor, in violation of subdivision (c) of Section 236.1" to the serious-felony list for Three Strikes purposes, shows a punitive direction but does not separate "Breaking the law needs to have real consequences — accountability is the priority" from "Impose the toughest penalties the law allows." One offense-specific enhancement, carrying the Legislature's stated intent "to protect victims of human trafficking and ensure they are not themselves criminalized," also does not exclude "Each situation is different — some people need support, some need consequences."
